deploy-bot: Deploy attempt to prod started by @maria for commit `a1b2c3d` (tag: v2.14.0). STATUS: BLOCKED by CI gate — 2 failing checks. CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/7890/jobs
ci-bot: Failing jobs: `e2e/payment-integration` (job #7890), `typecheck` (job #7892). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/7890/log
maria: ack, looking into the payment e2e failure now.
kevin: can anyone paste the failing stack? last night that webhook flaked a bit.
sam: queued a re-run: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/7893 (rerun triggered by sam).
jen: FYI change window ends in ~40m. if this doesn't green we'll need to abort and roll back to the last stable tag. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
kevin: quick scan — the e2e failure is a timeout waiting for the payment webhook: `TimeoutError: waited 30s for /webhook` — looks like rate-limit or infra flake, not app logic.
maria: that webhook has been noisy. for this deploy i'd prefer to wait for one rerun then decide. don't force deploy.
sam: rerun finished — both jobs still failing :x:. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/7893/log
kevin: yeah still same failure. i don't want to risk a canary with flaky payment flows. recommend rollback to v2.13.7 and re-run the test suite on the staging harness to get a reliable signal.
maria: agreed. starting manual abort/rollback to `v2.13.7`. tagging and notifying SRE. @jen can you add a short note on the release page about the blocked deploy? :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Manual override received from maria. Aborting rollout for tag `v2.14.0`. Initiating rollback to `v2.13.7`.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed in prod to tag `v2.13.7`. Canary not promoted. Closing thread. :lock:
